description_en: Verifies that a playbook configuration is correct and its orchestration logic is valid
description_zh: 校验剧本的配置是否正确，编排的逻辑是否合理
name: VerifyPlaybook

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the playbook.

Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
剧本的UUID。
调用[DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: playbook_uuid

parameters.help_en: The XML configuration of the playbook
parameters.name: task_flow

schema.description_en: The response parameters for the playbook verification

Detail.description_en: The specific error message that is returned if the verification fails
Detail.description_zh: 检查未通过时的具体错误信息
Detail.example: Node [python3_3] doesn't have the asset information

NodeName.description_en: The name of the playbook node

RiskLevel.description_en:
The severity level of the verification message. Valid values:

warn: A warning message. An issue may occur when the playbook runs.

error: An error message. The playbook fails to be compiled.

remind: A suggestion. This does not affect publishing or running the playbook. Optimize the playbook format
RiskLevel.description_zh:
校验信息的提示等级。取值：
warn：警告提示，在剧本运行过程中可能出现问题。
error：错误提示，剧本无法编译通过。
remind：建议提示，不影响剧本的发布与运行，建议优化剧本格式

Prerequisites.description_en: The prerequisite check information for the playbook

PrerequisiteType.description_en:
The check type. Valid values:

role: The name of the custom RAM role.

policies: The list of RAM system policies
PrerequisiteType.description_zh:
检验类型。取值：
role：RAM自定义角色名称。
policies：RAM系统策略列表

PrerequisiteValue.description_en:
The check content. The value is determined as follows:

If PrerequisiteType is role, the value is the static field AliyunSiemSoarExecutionDefaultRole.

If PrerequisiteType is policies, the value is a collection of policy names
PrerequisiteValue.description_zh:
检查内容。取值：
PrerequisiteType为role：为固定值 AliyunSiemSoarExecutionDefaultRole。
PrerequisiteType为policies：是策略名称的集合

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates this unique identifier for the request. Use this ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
